verdict.rationale: LegalZoom sells registered-agent service online at $249/year, lists its own address as the registered agent on public records, and files the registered-agent change with the Secretary of State itself. The evidence never says a founder receives the exact agent name and street address immediately, let alone the same day, to use in their own formation or change filing. missing for 10: documented same-day delivery of the agent name and street address to the buyer, explicit provisioning of these details for a self-filed formation document, independent or hands-on corroboration of turnaround.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day

citations.quote: Our address is listed as the registered agent on public records instead of yours, providing extra privacy
We'll also change the registered agent information with your Secretary of State.
